about: Academic & research writing pack (FIN-895): .build/release/ReadAloud --speech-test Tests/g2p/academic-readings.json. Speech cases say how citations, editors, equations, notes, circa and flourished, Greek letters and numbered citation brackets are read, in plain words. Every rule and general entry is heard by default; the one field-only entry (OR, odds ratio, O-R) is checked with the academic pack on and off. Frozen cases are text the pack must not touch, frozen with the app before the pack (origin/main at 0bd9fb7), except the last, which pins the field-only O-R reading with the pack on.
